equation: ln(N(t)) = intercept + slope * t_months, t_months = months since 2001-01
method: numpy.polyfit(deg=1) on ln(population) vs month index
validation_rule: 2021-01 to 2022-12 N_model_input = exp(intercept + slope*t_months); N_dataset for those months is recorded for audit only and is never used as model input (source_type=TRAIN_ONLY_EXTRAPOLATION).
